title: Hearty Earthy Croatian Whole Wheat Pilaf
description: This earthy Croatian whole wheat pilaf is a light and pillowy dish featuring whole wheat, cooked to perfection in a fondue pot using the bain-marie method, making it a great option for a shojin-friendly meal.
instructions: Rinse the whole wheat in a fine mesh strainer under cold running water, then drain well.
In the fondue pot, heat the olive oil over medium heat using the bain-marie method.
Add the chopped onion and cook, stirring occasionally, until softened and translucent.
Add the sliced mushrooms and cook, stirring occasionally, until they release their liquid and start to brown.
Add the minced garlic and cook, stirring constantly, for 1 minute.
Add the whole wheat, vegetable broth, salt, and black pepper, stirring to combine.
Bring the mixture to a simmer, then reduce the heat to low and cook, covered, until the liquid is absorbed and the whole wheat is tender.
Stir in the chopped fresh parsley and serve hot.
